decisions.reason: The camera sits close to the firm's core optical and navigation know-how and has its own page, so in-house R&D lets the firm interpret results and keep improving it.
This modular camera line builds directly on established expertise and has proven mission success with the HERA launch, so it fits squarely within the firm's absorptive capacity.
The SSA sensor suite extends existing sensor knowledge into a growing market, and the firm's research cooperations give it the related knowledge to assimilate early results.
The miniaturized LiDAR builds on the firm's docking LiDAR heritage and matches its push toward compact sensors, although its lower web visibility adds slight uncertainty.
This radiation-hard camera line is newly launched, close to core competencies and presented prominently, so the firm can readily learn from and refine it.
The asteroid camera builds on the firm's navigation camera heritage tied to deep-space missions, and its mission-specific nature only modestly raises the chance it is withdrawn.
